notes: Ana builds a settlement adjacent to Ben's settlement, breaking the distance rule.

lines.say: ok I have brick lumber wool and wheat so I'm building a settlement
I'll put it on this corner right next to your settlement Ben
the corner that's touching mine just one road away
yep right there it's the best spot

expect.fact: Distance rule: a settlement can't be built on an intersection adjacent to another settlement; there must be at least two road lengths between settlements.
